messages.content: Hi! Weekly check-in for this week. How are things?
Not great. Keep waking up at like 2am shaky and sweaty. Checked sugar and it's dropping to 50s
That's happening multiple times? And you're confirming with your meter each time?
Like 3 times this week. Meter says 50-54. I'm confused when it's happening, kinda scared.
Got it. This needs actual clinical help, not just logging. I'm escalating to our nurse team now—they'll reach out, usually within 31 hours. Can I log that you're seeing 50-54 readings at night?
Yeah log it. What do I do tonight tho
I can't give medical advice—that's the nurse's call. Just keep being careful and have your kit ready. Nurse will have real answers about what's causing it and how to fix it.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
